text:
Priya: Quick recap from Brightleaf call — they raised three concrete asks and called out renewal as 'likely' in Q4 if not addressed. Raw notes below.

Priya: 1) 'Per-route billing visibility' — they want to see token counts & cost per API route in the console so engineering + finance can reconcile monthly invoices.
Priya: 2) 'Non-dev onboarding checklist' — their ops team needs step-by-step SSO & VPC onboarding docs, not just SDK examples.
Priya: 3) 'Transient 503s during peak' — they see intermittent 503s on burst traffic; they want more resilient retry behavior.

Alex: Can we get the exact wording they'd prefer for the billing UI? Screenshot would help. Also, do they want per-route cost in $ or just token counts?

Marta: Account health snapshot: MRR $18k, usage grew 3x last month; renewal flagged as medium-high risk because onboarding stalled. If we don't show cost clarity or fix reliability, they'll escalate to procurement.

Jordan: On the 503s — we already have exponential backoff but maybe the client isn't retrying. Can you paste a request-id or a snippet of logs? Quick thought: bump client visible retries to 3 with jitter for a hotfix.

Samira: Support tickets SUP-3421 and SUP-3490 are both Brightleaf. Short excerpts:
Samira: "We hit 503s when sending batches above 2k tokens. Some requests succeed after retrying, others fail permanently." — customer.

Priya: Copying the customer's quoted ask for billing: "We need per-route daily token + $ breakdown so our finance team can map usage to product lines." — that seems clear.

Alex: Proposal: Treat 503 hotfix as P0 (customer impacting + renewal risk). Billing visibility = P1 (needs product design), Onboarding docs = P2 (docs / enablement). Voting: say 👍 for P0, 👀 for P1, 🟢 for P2.

feedback-bot: New poll created: "Priority for Brightleaf asks" — options: Fix 503 (P0), Billing visibility (P1), Onboarding docs (P2).

Marta: 👍 503 fix is the blocker for renewal.

Jordan: I'll estimate a hotfix today and put a short RFC into #eng-runtime. ETA for hotfix: 3–5 days; full resilience work 2–3 sprints.

Alex: I'll draft a product card for billing visibility with proposed fields (route, tokens/day, $/day, rolling 7d). Will attach mockups.

Samira: Tickets linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-3421 and https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-3490 — I'll consolidate conversation and add logs.

Priya: Action items: Jordan -> hotfix estimate + RFC; Alex -> product card + mockups; Samira -> consolidate tickets & logs; I'll update renewal playbook and flag this with CSM lead. Thanks all :raised_hands:

Jordan: ack, starting now.

Alex: tagging 'renewal-risk' on the card once it's up.

Marta: I'll prep a short email template for CSMs to use with Brightleaf once we have ETA.

Priya: I'll follow up on Friday with status and add to weekly CS sync.
